Hostel Admissions Frequently Asked Questions

Before contacting us, you may find it helpful to review some of our residents' frequently asked questions:

  • Is there a curfew time? Yes, the biometric entry gates lock at 10:00 PM daily for safety. Any late entry requires prior written approval from the resident warden.
  • Are laundry services free? Yes, laundry services (washing, drying, and ironing) are fully covered in the annual fee with no extra charges.
  • Can parents stay overnight? Parents can visit the common lobbies during daytime but are not permitted to stay overnight in student bedrooms. We can recommend nearby guest accommodations.
  • How is dining handled on holidays? Our kitchen is open throughout the academic year, serving weekend meals and special holiday lunches to ensure students are always taken care of.
